	"example.com/tcp-perf/protocol/msgid"
	"example.com/tcp-perf/protocol/pb"
	"github.com/spf13/viper"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/app"
	data "github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/dataengine"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/dataengine/engine"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/entity"

)

type loadNoEffects struct{}

func (loadNoEffects) Publish(context.Context, engine.OutboxItem) error {
	return errors.New("unexpected effect in generated TCP fixture")
}

type loadClient struct {
	conn                                  *session.Session
	id                                    int64
	mu                                    sync.Mutex
	decoder                               *entitysync.Decoder
	state                                 *db.PlayerDao
	syncPackets                           int
	syncError                             error
	accepted                              int64
	latency, scheduledLatency, queueDelay []int64
}

func (c *loadClient) request(id uint32, payload any) ([]byte, error) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 15*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	message, err := c.conn.CallChecked(ctx, id, id, payload, func(m *session.Message) error {
		switch r := m.Value.(type) {
		case *pb.AddGoldResponse:
			if r.Code != 0 {
				return session.ErrRejected
			}
		case *pb.EnterGameResponse:
			if r.Code != 0 {
				return session.ErrRejected
			}
		default:
			return fmt.Errorf("invalid response %T", m.Value)
		}
		return nil
	})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return message.Packet.Payload, nil
}
func (c *loadClient) push(m *session.Message) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	if c.syncError != nil {
		return
	}
	decoded, err := c.decoder.Decode(m.Packet.Payload)
	if err != nil {
		c.syncError = err
		return
	}
	for _, obj := range decoded.Objects {
		for _, component := range obj.Components {
			if err := c.state.ApplySync(component.Update.Payload.BytesCopy()); err != nil {
				c.syncError = err
				return
			}
		}
	}
	c.syncPackets++
}
func (c *loadClient) synced() (int64, int, error) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	return c.state.GetGold(), c.syncPackets, c.syncError
}

func TestGeneratedTCPPersistentLoad(t *testing.T) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 8*time.Minute)
	defer cancel()
	uri, database := os.Getenv("ROOST_DATAENGINE_IT_MONGO_URI"), os.Getenv("ROOST_GENERATED_TCP_DB")
	if uri == "" || !strings.HasPrefix(database, "roost_generated_tcp_") {
		t.Fatal("isolated Mongo and unique fixture database required")
	}
	if err := registry.RegisterAll(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	client, err := mongodriver.NewClient(fmongo.DefaultConfig(uri), mongodriver.IndexMigrationPolicy{})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() { _ = client.Close(context.Background()) })
	mapping, _, err := data.NewDatabaseMap(data.DatabaseMapConfig{Declared: data.DeclaredDatabases(), Configured: map[string]string{db.DatabaseMain: database}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	store, err := engine.NewMongoStore(client, engine.MongoStoreConfig{DefaultDatabase: database, Databases: mapping})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := store.EnsureInfrastructure(ctx); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	walOpts := nestwal.DefaultOptions(os.Getenv("ROOST_GENERATED_TCP_WAL"))
	walOpts.GroupCommitInterval = 2 * time.Millisecond
	wal, err := nestwal.Open(walOpts)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	projector, err := engine.NewProjector(wal, store, engine.ProjectorOptions{})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	outboxStore, err := engine.NewMongoOutboxStore(store)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	outbox, err := engine.NewOutboxWorker(outboxStore, loadNoEffects{}, engine.OutboxWorkerOptions{Owner: database})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	runtime, err := engine.NewRuntime(store, wal, projector, outbox, EntityAccess, nil, nil, engine.PipelinedRuntimeConfig{Allowlist: []string{"handlerAddGold"}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := runtime.Start(ctx); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		stopCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
		defer cancel()
		if err := runtime.Shutdown(stopCtx); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
	})
	probe, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	addr := probe.Addr().String()
	_ = probe.Close()
	cfg := viper.New()
	cfg.Set("player_access.tcp.enabled", true)
	cfg.Set("player_access.tcp.addr", addr)
	cfg.Set("sync.entity.interval", "10ms")
	reg := app.NewRegistry(cfg)
	if err := reg.Register(mods.ModDataEngine, runtime); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	enabled := os.Getenv("SELF_SYNC") == "1"
	nestMod := kitnest.NewMod(EntityAccess)
	tcp := accessplayertcp.NewMod()
	if enabled {
		nestMod = kitnest.NewModWithEntitySync(EntityAccess, PlayerSelfSync.EntitySyncSetup())
		tcp = tcp.WithSelfSync(PlayerSelfSync)
	}
	access := accessplayer.NewMod()
	all := []app.Mod{nestMod, access, tcp}
	for _, mod := range all {
		if err := mod.Init(cfg); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(mod.Name(), err)
		}
	}
	for _, mod := range all {
		if p, ok := mod.(interface{ Provide(*app.Registry) error }); ok {
			if err := p.Provide(reg); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(mod.Name(), err)
			}
		}
	}
	for _, mod := range all {
		if err := mod.Start(); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(mod.Name(), err)
		}
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		stopCtx, c := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
		defer c()
		if err := tcp.StopWithContext(stopCtx); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
		if err := nestMod.StopWithContext(stopCtx); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
	})
	n, _ := strconv.Atoi(os.Getenv("CONNECTIONS"))
	seconds, _ := strconv.Atoi(os.Getenv("ROOST_GENERATED_TCP_SECONDS"))
	rate, rateErr := strconv.Atoi(os.Getenv("OPEN_LOOP_RATE"))
	if rateErr != nil || rate < 0 || rate > 100000 {
		t.Fatal("OPEN_LOOP_RATE must be 0..100000")
	}
	if n < 1 || n > 5000 || seconds < 1 || seconds > 300 {
		t.Fatal("connections must be 1..5000, seconds 1..300")
	}
	clients := make([]*loadClient, n)
	enter := &pb.EnterGameRequest{}
	payload := &pb.AddGoldRequest{}
	protocols := robotprotocol.NewRegistry(nil)
	protocol.RegisterDefaults(protocols)
	recorder := &session.Recorder{}
	for i := range clients {
		sequence := int64(10000 + i)
		if os.Getenv("ENTITY_MODE") == "shared" {
			sequence = 10000
		}
		id, err := entity.BuildEntityID(sequence, player.EntityKindPlayer)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		conn, err := transport.DialPlayerTCP(ctx, transport.Config{Endpoint: addr})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := conn.WritePackets([]*transport.Packet{transport.AuthPacket(fmt.Sprintf("player:%d:%d", sequence, i))}); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		authTimer := time.AfterFunc(15*time.Second, func() { _ = conn.Close() })
		ack, err := conn.ReadPacket()
		authTimer.Stop()
		if err != nil || ack.MsgID != 0 {
			t.Fatal("login ack", ack, err)
		}
		c := &loadClient{conn: session.New(conn, protocols, recorder), id: id, decoder: entitysync.NewDecoder(frame.Limits{}), state: db.NewPlayerDao()}
		clients[i] = c
		t.Cleanup(func() { _ = c.conn.Close() })
		c.conn.RegisterPushHandler(msgid.MsgSelfSync, c.push)
		raw, err := c.request(msgid.MsgEnterGame, enter)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		response, err := pb.UnmarshalEnterGameResponse(raw)
		if err != nil || response.Code != 0 {
			t.Fatal("enter", response, err)
		}
	}
	if err := projector.Flush(ctx); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	baseline := projector.Stats()
	walBefore := wal.Stats()
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	var failed, dropped, offered atomic.Int64
	errorsOut := make(chan error, n)
	start := time.Now()
	duration := time.Duration(seconds) * time.Second
	until := start.Add(duration)
	// 每条连接只有一个读写 owner；开环调度独立于响应，队列有界，满时记录丢弃而不阻塞到变成闭环。
	jobs := make(chan time.Time, n*2)
	for _, c := range clients {
		wg.Go(func() {
			for {
				planned := time.Now()
				if rate > 0 {
					var ok bool
					planned, ok = <-jobs
					if !ok {
						return
					}
				} else {
					if !planned.Before(until) {
						return
					}
					offered.Add(1)
				}
				sent := time.Now()
				raw, err := c.request(msgid.MsgAddGold, payload)
				if err != nil {
					failed.Add(1)
					errorsOut <- err
					return
				}
				response, err := pb.UnmarshalAddGoldResponse(raw)
				if err != nil || response.Code != 0 {
					failed.Add(1)
					errorsOut <- fmt.Errorf("add reply %+v: %v", response, err)
					return
				}
				finished := time.Now()
				c.accepted++
				c.latency = append(c.latency, finished.Sub(sent).Microseconds())
				c.scheduledLatency = append(c.scheduledLatency, finished.Sub(planned).Microseconds())
				c.queueDelay = append(c.queueDelay, sent.Sub(planned).Microseconds())
			}
		})
	}
	if rate > 0 {
		count := int64(seconds) * int64(rate)
		for i := int64(0); i < count; i++ {
			planned := start.Add(time.Duration(i) * time.Second / time.Duration(rate))
			if wait := time.Until(planned); wait > 0 {
				timer := time.NewTimer(wait)
				select {
				case <-timer.C:
				case <-ctx.Done():
					timer.Stop()
					t.Fatal(ctx.Err())
				}
			}
			offered.Add(1)
			if time.Since(planned) >= time.Second/time.Duration(rate) {
				dropped.Add(1)
				continue
			}
			select {
			case jobs <- planned:
			default:
				dropped.Add(1)
			}
		}
		close(jobs)
	}
	wg.Wait()
	elapsed := time.Since(start)
	if rate > 0 {
		for range jobs {
			dropped.Add(1)
		}
	}
	close(errorsOut)
	var accepted int64
	expected := map[int64]int64{}
	var latency, scheduled, queue []int64
	for _, c := range clients {
		accepted += c.accepted
		expected[c.id] += c.accepted
		latency = append(latency, c.latency...)
		scheduled = append(scheduled, c.scheduledLatency...)
		queue = append(queue, c.queueDelay...)
	}
	// 停止业务后先等待全部投影；最终值从新 Manager/Repository 冷加载，不用热实体替代持久验证。
	drainStart := time.Now()
	if err := projector.Flush(ctx); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	drainTime := time.Since(drainStart)
	cold, err := engine.NewEntityRepository(entity.NewEntityManager(), store, runtime)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var persisted int64
	for id, want := range expected {
		v, err := cold.LoadEntity(ctx, id, player.EntityKindPlayer)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		got := v.(*player.Player).Dao().GetGold()
		if got != want {
			t.Fatalf("cold Gold id=%d got=%d acknowledged=%d", id, got, want)
		}
		persisted += got
	}
	syncPackets := 0
	if enabled {
		for _, c := range clients {
			deadline := time.Now().Add(15 * time.Second)
			for {
				gold, packets, err := c.synced()
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal("self sync", err)
				}
				if gold == expected[c.id] {
					syncPackets += packets
					break
				}
				if time.Now().After(deadline) {
					t.Fatalf("self sync gold %d want %d", gold, expected[c.id])
				}
				time.Sleep(time.Millisecond)
			}
		}
	}
	stats := projector.Stats()
	if accepted == 0 || offered.Load() != accepted+failed.Load()+dropped.Load() || stats.WALUnacked != 0 {
		t.Fatal("load accounting or WAL drain mismatch", offered.Load(), accepted, failed.Load(), dropped.Load(), stats)
	}
	report := map[string]any{
		"durability":                      os.Getenv("DURABILITY"),
		"self_sync":                       enabled,
		"entity_mode":                     os.Getenv("ENTITY_MODE"),
		"connections":                     n,
		"entities":                        len(expected),
		"seconds":                         seconds,
		"open_loop_rate":                  rate,
		"offered":                         offered.Load(),
		"accepted":                        accepted,
		"errors":                          failed.Load(),
		"dropped":                         dropped.Load(),
		"elapsed_seconds":                 elapsed.Seconds(),
		"acknowledged_tps":                float64(accepted) / elapsed.Seconds(),
		"tcp_rtt_us":                      loadPercentiles(latency),
		"scheduled_to_reply_us":           loadPercentiles(scheduled),
		"client_queue_us":                 loadPercentiles(queue),
		"projection_drain_ms":             drainTime.Milliseconds(),
		"projected_during_load_and_drain": stats.Projected - baseline.Projected,
		"wal_unacked":                     stats.WALUnacked,
		"wal_append_records":              wal.Stats().Appended - walBefore.Appended,
		"wal_syncs":                       wal.Stats().Syncs - walBefore.Syncs,
		"persisted_gold":                  persisted,
		"cold_verified":                   true,
		"self_sync_packets":               syncPackets,
		"capacity_claim":                  false,
		"robot_requests":                  recorder.Snapshot(),
	}
	encoded, err := json.MarshalIndent(report, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(os.Getenv("ROOST_GENERATED_TCP_REPORT"), append(encoded, '\n'), 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Log(string(encoded))
	for err := range errorsOut {
		t.Error(err)
	}
	if failed.Load() != 0 {
		return
	}
	for _, c := range clients {
		_ = c.conn.Close()
	}
	if err := tcp.StopWithContext(ctx); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := nestMod.StopWithContext(ctx); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := runtime.Shutdown(ctx); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := client.Database(database).Drop(ctx); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
func loadPercentiles(samples []int64) map[string]int64 {
	if len(samples) == 0 {
		return map[string]int64{}
	}
	slices.Sort(samples)
	return map[string]int64{"p50": samples[(len(samples)*50+99)/100-1], "p99": samples[(len(samples)*99+99)/100-1], "max": samples[len(samples)-1]}
}
